name: Laguna Capri
region: Los Glaciares National Park, north sector
why: Fitz Roy reflected in a forest lake in half a day, without the last brutal climb.
water: A stream near the lake; carry 1 litre.
dangers: Steady climb in the first hour; easy after that.

points.name: Fitz Roy trailhead, El Chaltén
points.note: The same start as Laguna de los Tres.

points.name: Mirador del Río de las Vueltas
points.note: After 30 minutes: the valley of the Río de las Vueltas opens below.

points.name: Laguna Capri
points.note: 750 m. Walk around the shore to the camp side for Fitz Roy over the water.
